note: Small gravel RV park on the north edge of Versailles (506 N Walnut Ave) beside the highway: full-hookup back-ins and two pull-throughs, plus one 25-ft back-in with electric and water only. Takes both overnight and long-term guests. RVs more than 10 years old need the park's approval first. No open fires except in a fire pit; one shared pit. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site and Campspot: full hookups 30/50A, 9 sites sold nightly online (6 back-in, 2 pull-through, 1 limited-hookup), $25/$35/$45 before Campspot's $3 fee, weekday and weekend alike in November 2026; 2-night minimum still on the full-hookup types. Under the $50 gate. Rig-age rule re-read. Google 4.8 over 25. Phone and website match; pin on the lot; not waterfront stands.
flags: RIG-AGE RULE, current wording: Campspot terms - 'No camper vehicles may be older than 10 years to date. Exceptions may be granted upon request.'; each site type's description - 'Recreational vehicles coming to the park must be 2015 or newer. Please contact the park if you plan on bringing an older RV.' The operator's own website does not state it. A 2023 motorhome passes.

SUMMER QUOTE NOT AVAILABLE: Campspot returned no site types for 2027-04-16, 2027-05-21, 2027-06-11, 2027-06-12 and 2027-07-02 (the calendar is not open that far ahead), so no summer-weekend quote exists yet. The November weekend quote equals the weekday one; fees.nightly_high 45 is unverified for summer 2027.
MINIMUM STAY: the standing 2-night minimum on the two full-hookup types is still there (stored, kept and marked); the limited-hookup back-in sells one night but is capped at 25 ft and has no sewer.

NIGHTLY VS LONG-TERM: Campspot sells 9 sites (numbers 01, 02, 08, 14, 15, 18, 19, 20, 21); the numbering implies about 21 sites, so roughly a dozen are not offered online and are presumably the long-term ones ('offers both short and long-term stays'; a Google review quoted on the site mentions a monthly rate). The total count is not published, so sites.count was not written. The leaf-off frame shows about ten units on a single gravel lot. The site-map PDF linked from the website is an image and gave no text; it was not read.
RATINGS: Google 4.8 over 25 (unchanged); Campspot 4.8 over 5. RV Life was not re-read (stored: unrated).
EXTRA PERSON: no extra-person charge is posted on the website or in the Campspot terms; the quote was for 2 adults only. Not written.
